hypotheses.D1_context_assignment_matters: Shuffling hard route assignments while preserving usage raises mean exact KL by at least 25% on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_context_beats_position_only: Native hard routing reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to the best position-only control on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_no_single_expert_matches_router: The best fixed expert has at least 10% higher mean exact KL than native hard routing on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_experts_are_distinct_subspaces: Every expert pair has mean canonical cosine below 0.90.
hypotheses.D5_hard_router_beats_global32: Native hard routing reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to global rank 32 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D6_uniform_ensemble_is_insufficient: Uniform expert averaging has higher mean exact KL than native hard routing on every corpus.
